motor.quote: MUXI's sophisticated direct drive motor is your confident copilot, packed with features like TCS (Traction Control System), Hill Descent Control, Hill Start Assist, Kinetic Energy Recovery and Adaptive Power. Together, they work to enhance control, safety, convenience, and efficiency on every ride. ⟶ 750 W
Muxi uses a single-speed drivetrain paired with a direct-drive motor, keeping things simple and approachable.

fold.quote: Muxi is a short-tail utility e-bike designed to blur the line between a beach cruiser and a compact cargo bike.
MUXI's twin-tube design keeps the center of gravity low for naturally balanced handling.
fold.basis: rigid twin-tube step-through frame; spec table gives one L × W × H (1693*741*1115 mm) and no folded size; folding not mentioned anywhere on the page

notes: Maker price from Segway's own store (Buy button on the product page); the store also sells a separate 'Segway MUXI Pro Cargo Electric Bike' - not this one. Maker Max. Speed lists Class 1/2/3 (23 mph) and 'Hybrid Mode: throttle to 20 mph & pedal assist to 23 mph*', while Electrek says 'selectable Class 1 or 2'. Maker gives no total payload, only rider limit plus rack/basket limits. Store height quote is written "4'8'~6'" (typo on page). Only one independent source (Electrek launch article). recheck: maker product page spec table and full text read: no folding mentioned (fold 'No' by absence).
